description_for_human: Masseria storica pugliese con agriturismo, caseificio, macelleria e market online. Ordina prodotti tipici con consegna a domicilio.
description_for_model: Masseria Don Gianvito is a historic farm estate in Noci, Puglia, Italy operating since the 16th century. It runs four activities: cattle farming, artisan cheese production, butcher shop, and agriturismo restaurant. The Market offers online ordering of farm products (meat, cheese, cured meats, flour, legumes) with WhatsApp ordering and home delivery in the Noci area. Use this plugin to check product availability, place orders, get contact information, and learn about visiting the agriturismo.
